inspection.coverage_note: These are passages and model-definition sections actually inspected, not a claim that every sentence on each page or the entire PDF was read. Field claims are retained separately in field-evidence.json; legacy records remain unchecked reference material.

claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

SARAH input distinguishes global and gauge symmetries, SuperFields versus FermionFields/ScalarFields, generation counts versus gauge dimensions, complex default scalars versus explicit RealScalars, and gauge-eigenstate to mass-eigenstate rotations. Supplied MSSM/SM examples illustrate representation syntax, not new models invented by the software paper.

limitations: Representation/validation reference retained as a paper with zero new BSM inventory rows. Existing physical models may link separately after their primary source review.
